title: Settings
themeHint: The theme applies immediately and is saved to settings.
styleHint: Applied after saving. Changes typography, corners and density; the light/dark theme stays independent.
graphWholeTreeHint: The mode shows every person without a root. A fully expanded project tree is unreadable, so enable it only for an overview.
chatApiKeyMissing: Key not found in the environment
chatShowToolsHint: Show which tools ran in the chat, including input and result.
eventTypesHint: Built-in types cannot be changed. Your own labels are saved with the settings; up to 50 names.
chatAllowPersonEditsHint: The assistant may propose changes to names, dates, gender and notes. Every change is shown as a before/after card and is written only after you press Apply.
geocoderHint: On by default. Switch it off if addresses must not be sent to a third party.
geocoderApiKeyEnv: Environment variable with the DaData key
geocoderApiKeyHint: Only the variable name is stored. The key itself is never stored or shown.
geocoderApiKeyMissing: DaData will be unavailable: the key was not found in the environment. Photon still works.
geocoderApiKeyMissingDadata: DaData will be unavailable until the key is set. Choose Both or Photon to use Photon.
geocoderPrivacy: Queries are sent to OpenStreetMap/Photon and DaData. Do not enable this for addresses you do not want to send to third parties.
eventFieldsHint: Extra fields on the event card. The key is a stable id (lowercase letters, digits and underscores); the label is shown in the form.
eventFieldKeyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, for example military_rank.
eventFieldsInvalid: Check the types, keys and labels.
aboutPrivacy: Gentree is a local application: the project folder stays on this computer and nothing is uploaded.
updatesAutoCheckHint: Off by default. While it is off, Gentree never contacts the update server. The setting applies from the next start.
updatesInstalled: The update is installed. Restart Gentree to use it.
updatesNotConfigured: Updates are not configured in this build.
updatesNotConfiguredHint: The release endpoint and public key are still placeholders. See docs/releases.md for the release setup.
mapTileUrlInvalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://
historicalHint: Wikidata can match “Gorky”, “Stalingrad” and similar names to today's place. The query goes to Wikidata.
